# A swarm of five murk moths: a body, two flat wings (two-sided) raised in a shallow V and a
# pair of glowing eyes each, at 0.55-0.9 m over the ground round the swarm's centre. One bone.
# Generated by make_models.py. Up Z, front -Y.
new
material new Wing --base-color 0.6392 0.6549 0.7608 --no-slot
material new Body --base-color 0.4078 0.4353 0.6000 --no-slot
material new Eye --base-color 1.0000 0.3216 0.4667 --no-slot --emission 1.0000 0.3216 0.4667
add mesh ico-sphere --name B0 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.05 --location 0 0 0
scale 1 2.2 1
apply --scale
material assign Body
add mesh plane --name WL0 --size 1 --location -0.1 0.02 0.0
scale 0.17 0.15 1
apply --scale
set rotation 0 22 8
apply --rotation
material assign Wing
add mesh plane --name WR0 --size 1 --location 0.1 0.02 0.0
scale 0.17 0.15 1
apply --scale
set rotation 0 -22 -8
apply --rotation
material assign Wing
add mesh cube --name E0 --size 1 --location 0.0000 -0.1050 0.0100
scale 0.075 0.035 0.035
apply --scale
material assign Eye
select B0 WL0 WR0 E0
active B0
